name: Bhargav Sai Bhartu
headline: Python & AI Developer
summary: Python and AI developer at PHYTEC India building practical computer vision and workflow automation software. Designed and shipped an on-premises face recognition attendance platform end-to-end—covering anti-spoofing liveness checks, FastAPI, PostgreSQL with pgvector, a live HR dashboard, and a PWA mobile client—backed by 91 automated tests. Also builds LLM-powered workflows and CRM integrations with n8n.

Build and maintain n8n automation workflows that capture marketing leads and route incoming sales inquiries.
Integrate website inquiry forms with Odoo CRM via webhooks and REST APIs, including payload validation and automated sales notifications.
